summary: The individual expresses concerns about the use of generative AI in schools and the lack of parental consent, while also advocating for the continuation of E-Rate funding to support educational needs.

claims.argument: Limiting or sunsetting E-Rate would reduce funding for broadband access in schools
claims.evidence_quote: Last year, I opted my children out of their school-issued Chromebooks after Gemini began speaking to my middle schooler, unprompted. It offered to do his homework for him. As a therapist in private practice who has seen firsthand what relational AI can do to children, that was enough for me.
